prompts.template: Scan Senior Health subtopic '{subtopic}'. Return topics as a JSON array matching the SYS_08 whitespace schema. For each item include vi, ever, ctr, comp, computed opportunity, and why_missed. Exclude any topic with competition >= 7 unless a relief or curiosity anchor is viable.
For claim '{claim}', return JSON {claim, citation:{tier,source}, mechanism, contraindications[]}. Use SYS_09 tiers 1-4 only. If unsupportable, set citation to null and flag 'CUT'.

Generate 5 titles for '{topic}' / '{payoff}' with anchor '{anchor}'. Apply SYS_04 template_registry and generation rules TR1-TR7. Return JSON titles[] with template_id and SYS_14 title_score. Reject implausible numbers and full disclosure.
Produce a SYS_06 spec plus 5 concepts for '{topic}' with layout_class '{class}'. Enforce visual rules V1-V6. Return JSON {spec, concepts[], dominant_word}.
Write a 60-second hook for '{topic}' using the SYS_05 beat_schema. Opening strategy '{O_id}'. Enforce hook rules HR1-HR4. Return per-beat text keyed by beat number.

Write a full script for '{title}' using the SYS_10 state machine. Enforce invariants I1-I6. Insert one SYS_09 tier 1-4 citation and a clinician caveat. Maintain a loop every 60-90 seconds and reveal items in ascending importance. Return JSON {script, loop_map[]}.
Audit this script against SYS_09 rules M1-M8 and the policy_compliance_check. Return JSON {result, violations[{rule_id, location}]}. Set result to 'fail' if any block-severity rule is violated.

governance.rationale: Prompts reference rule IDs rather than restating rules so upstream rule changes propagate automatically.
governance.add_new_prompt_when: a genuinely new task category emerges
